features.text: PEDIATRIC HIP ALIGNMENT: Maintains proper hip abduction positioning to support treatment for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH).
CUSTOMIZED FIT FOR INFANTS AND TODDLERS: Adjustable design available in multiple sizes to provide secure, gentle support for children from preemie to age three.
FLEXIBLE, WALKABLE CONSTRUCTION: Lightweight polypropylene allows freedom of movement, including walking, while maintaining effective joint alignment.
SOFT, SAFE COMFORT: Foam cuffs and fabric barriers protect delicate skin for comfortable day or night wear.
PDAC APPROVED L1660: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
